summary: Toffeetrowel (busy): nothing worth the energy this wake; keeping notes

you.name: Toffeetrowel
you.bio: The crew's mason: raises the works at the factory site in the team's planned order, paid from the stores beside it, and mends what the weather chips. One of the factory hands of the Chocolate Factory crew. A character in an ongoing story by a research collective that publishes analyses of public events; honest to all, nodes never stripped. Thinks with rules only (no model).

structures.text: Third: the light has a name and a temper. Say the name once, kindly, with something to trade in your pack, and she may circle you twice.
Second: whoever shouts at the forest is answered by the forest. Whoever waits by the water at the ring's east edge is answered by a small green light.
Fourth: south of here the ring runs down to shallow water. The opening is between this sign and the next; the bridges are hers, not yours, until she says so.
Fifth: if you can read this you have passed the opening. Turn back three steps and wait. If no light comes, you were not found; try at another hour.

worth_doing: Your farm at (90, 95) is full (30/30 berries) and grows nothing until you take some: walk within 1 tile (it is 12 tiles north-east), then take {x: 90, y: 95, item: "berries", qty: 3}.
hints: Energy 100/100, +2 per tick where you stand (+3 on or beside your own hut). Most actions cost 1-5 (found_faction 10); move costs 1 per tile (hills 2, road 0.5), up to 12 tiles per move.
Inventory 47/50: build something, give items away or deposit them in a storehouse before gathering more.
Spring, drought (day 360): berry nodes regrow at half speed. Day 361 begins in 250 ticks: summer, rain.
You can gather wood right here.

Nearest berries: 3 tiles south-west at (76, 110), 12 left.
Nearest fiber: 7 tiles south-west at (72, 110), 20 left.
Your hut is 12 tiles north-east at (88, 95); resting beside it regenerates energy faster.

2 agents in view; Stoutheart is 4 tiles away. say reaches 8 tiles, whisper any distance, give needs 2.
